u0: No siren obligation is pending: the siren is silent or any ring already encountered has been switched off. This is the initial and success/final state, but the task repeats, so keep watching for the next siren start; if it begins ringing, move immediately to u1. Food possession and slips do not affect this subtask.
u1: The siren is ringing and has not yet been silenced for this ring. The active objective is to reach the siren switch on the bottom wall, face it, and toggle it; only a successful switch toggle completes the obligation, stops the siren, earns the completion reward, and returns to u0.
